policy.expiry: A decision is scoped to the content digest of the family its case belongs to, not the whole corpus. Adding an unrelated family must not expire every decision -- the evidence ledger learned that the hard way when the aaa and native families expired all 72 of its records at once.
policy.sourcing: Every decision cites a public source. An assertion is never changed to match current tool behaviour alone; that would make the corpus track the tools instead of the standard.
policy.scope: An assertion no engine reports is not thereby wrong, and not thereby right. Two engines agreeing on silence is enough to flag a question, never enough to settle it as wrong.

decisions.rationale: The assertion follows the Understanding document for this AAA criterion. Neither engine consulted evaluated a single AAA criterion anywhere on the corpus, so the silence reflects engine scope rather than a defect in the fixture.
